title: feat(nfplaq): plaquette holonomy: reverse fail, face fails
science: Only gauge-flavoured readout in the band: plaquette opposite-vertex holonomy of the own-incoming lock field. On the elementary seed-square Q={0,e_1,e_1+e_2,e_2} the cycle sum is H=(2,0,0)!=0, i.e. the record-formation lock field carries nonzero Z^3 holonomy around the unit plaquette and is not exact. Also records the star-aggregation alternative value L(A)=(5,0,0).
